notes: POLICY P8 (2026-08-23): 'Payer Name' renamed to 'Drawer Name' and 'Amount' to 'Amount in Figures'. The party who writes and signs a cheque is the DRAWER (UCC Art. 3 and ordinary banking usage); 'Payer' is colloquial and confusable with the payee. A cheque states its amount twice, in figures and in words, and they can disagree — which is why both are printed — so 'Amount' does not say which was read. GOLD WAS CORRECTED; the engine's vocabulary was already right. Values unchanged. Single-page cheque (Non-Negotiable Copy). Routing 021000021 and account 7743882201 come from the MICR line 'A021000021A C7743882201C 001847D' and match the ABA/account printed on the invoices' payment instructions. Both are typed string — leading zeros matter. POLICY P5: 'Cheque Number' is the header 'No:' field form 'CHQ-001847', not the bare MICR serial '001847'. POLICY P6: 'Amount in Words' is the FULL printed string including the '*** U.S. DOLLARS ***' anti-tamper decoration.
